const saved = await eda.sch_Document.save();
console.log('saved:', saved);

_source.title: 保存文档
_source.example.text.0: 1. 创建测试原理图并打开（保存作用于当前激活的原理图，openDocument 传图页级 UUID）
_source.example.text.2: 3. 清理测试原理图（删除前等 1.5s 让保存变更同步落地）
_source.returns: 保存操作是否成功，保存失败、上传失败等错误均返回 `false`

title: Save Document
returns: Whether the save operation was successful. Errors such as save failure and upload failure all return `false`
